credits._noteLowestRate: Schedule 1: BPA and Canada employment credit use 15% (statutory), not the effective first-bracket rate.

basicPersonalAmount._note: 2025 CRA indexation table. Maximum BPA when net income ≤ start of 29% bracket; minimum when net income ≥ start of 33% bracket; linear phase-out between. Credit = amount × lowestRateForCredits (15%).

canadaEmploymentAmount._note: 2025 CRA indexation: Canada employment amount (maximum). Credit = amount × lowestRateForCredits.

ageAmount._note: CRA 2025 line 30100 / indexation table. Claim $9,028 if net income ≤ $45,522; reduced by 15% of net income above that threshold (ITA 118(2)).

pensionIncomeAmount._note: Federal pension income amount (line 31400) is $2,000. Not CPI-indexed. Eligibility of the income is determined by the caller.

oasRecovery._source: CRA indexation table: Old age security repayment threshold 2025. canada.ca recovery-tax page.
oasRecovery._note: Repay 15% of line 23400 above the threshold, not exceeding OAS received.

_note: 2025 CRA-indexed brackets and BPA ($16,129 max / $14,538 min). Canada employment amount $1,471 (CRA indexation table). RRSP 2025: 18% of prior-year earned income, max $32,490.
